title: NSA purges Borland's JWICS document database
summary: Dylan Borland tells of NSA purges Borland's JWICS document database, about 2024 at JWICS / Intelink classified networks, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So I had told you that in 2024 I had a large database saved of documents, briefings, private messages on classified on JWIX.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says he worked with classified US systems, says that in 2024 he had saved a large collection of documents, briefings and private messages on JWICS, a top-secret US government computer network for intelligence. He says the NSA, the US National Security Agency that handles electronic intelligence, wiped that collection out. He tells it as a sign that someone wanted the UFO-related material he had gathered erased.
